what: the parser's descent needs more stack than the smallest declared stack holds: each Disjunction it reads takes a 64 KiB frame and asks whether the stack has room, so a pattern at the nesting maximum does not complete on a 1 MiB thread (attempt 1 took 4 KiB a level; its deciding tests failed, but each failure's stack trace ran some hundreds of levels deep and its test log and trx are over 2 MB, kept by digest only; a larger frame fails at a shallower depth)
